Title: Generally Available: Kubernetes 1.25 support in AKS

Body.Content:
AKS support for Kubernetes release 1.25 is now generally available. Kubernetes 1.25 delivers 40 enhancements. This release includes new changes such as the removal of PodSecurityPolicy.

Visit the official Kubernetes website to learn more.
